# Measured contrast, phase 2 compositions

Sampled from the rendered PNG, not computed from CSS. Method in
`compositions/RECOMMENDATION.md`.

## Composition A, split

Text sits on `--paper`. Values recorded in `tokens.css` and independent of the image.

| pair | ratio | threshold | verdict |
|---|---:|---:|---|
| `--navy-800` on `--paper` | 14.63:1 | 4.5 | PASS |
| `--ink-700` on `--paper` | 9.21:1 | 4.5 | PASS |
| `--navy-600` on `--paper` | 7.34:1 | 4.5 | PASS |
| `--paper` on `--navy-800` (primary button) | 14.63:1 | 4.5 | PASS |

## Composition B, scrim

Text sits over photography. Measured against the actual composite backdrop of
`images/hero/tower-360.jpg` behind the mandated `--scrim-photo`.

| text run | lightest backdrop | ratio | threshold | verdict |
|---|---|---:|---:|---|
| eyebrow `--on-navy-secondary` | rgb(228,201,173) | 1.34:1 | 4.5 | **FAIL** |
| h1 `--paper` | rgb(196,181,153) | 2.02:1 | 3.0 large | **FAIL** |
| lead `--paper` | rgb(121,92,71) | 6.11:1 | 4.5 | PASS |

The scrim runs `.78` at the bottom to transparent at 75% height. The eyebrow and h1
sit in the upper half of the copy block where the scrim is near `.35`, over a sunset
sky. That is the failure.

This is a property of the pairing, not of the scrim, which is used at exactly the
value rules/01 mandates and was not adjusted.
